description.zh: 读取 Anatomy 技能自带的文件（references/*.md 指南、kit/ 源码、examples/ 示例源码、scripts/），路径形如 "references/craft.md"；给目录则列出内容；不给 path 则返回 Anatomy 版本、Node.js 与 Chrome 是否可用。
description.en: Read files shipped with the Anatomy skill (references/*.md guides, kit/ sources, examples/ sources, scripts/), path like "references/craft.md"; a folder lists its contents; no path returns the Anatomy version and whether Node.js and Chrome are available.

path.description: 技能目录内的相对路径，如 references/kit.md 或 examples/dial-indicator/build.mjs；留空返回状态
path inside the skill folder, e.g. references/kit.md or examples/dial-indicator/build.mjs; empty returns status
